subject.title: [Feature]: Support Excel (.xlsx/.xls) and generic binary uploads in gateway / input_file

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Gateway `input_file` binary workspace-receipt contract for Excel and generic binaries, and what default MIME, persistence, redaction, and tool-access policy should it use?
rationale: The remaining work changes a public Gateway API and security boundary; an automated fix cannot safely choose whether this belongs in core, a plugin extractor, provider-native forwarding, or a narrower opt-in artifact path.

options.title: Approve narrow Gateway receipt contract
options.body: Add a generic, security-reviewed `input_file` artifact path with explicit allowlists, byte caps, sanitized metadata, redaction rules, docs, and tests before adding richer Excel preview/parsing.

options.title: Defer to provider/document tracks
options.body: Keep this issue open as design input while broader provider-native forwarding and document-extraction issues settle the shared content contract first.

options.title: Keep text/PDF-only defaults
options.body: Document Excel and generic binaries as unsupported for `/v1/responses` until maintainers decide the security and persistence model is worth adding.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow Gateway receipt contract
recommendation.body: Add a generic, security-reviewed `input_file` artifact path with explicit allowlists, byte caps, sanitized metadata, redaction rules, docs, and tests before adding richer Excel preview/parsing.

likelyOwner.reason: The central decision concerns the Gateway/OpenResponses input contract, where this history shows foundational ownership signals.
